B31.visual_intent: Act title 'Wobble the Result' (serif 40) top-left. A rectangle (the sprite) with four terracotta corner dots and the definition 'vertex: a corner point of a shape'. 'vertex' flashes on each dot in turn; the top-right and bottom-right dots slide down and the rectangle leans into a parallelogram with straight edges. A faint dashed curve tries to bend the top edge but the edge stays straight. Caption 'four corners, straight edges'.
B31.motion_claim: Two corners slide and the whole shape leans; the edge between them stays a straight line.

show.event: two corners slide, the shape leans

B31.why: Four dots, two of which slide while the edges stay straight, is the limit as motion.

B35.motion_claim: The face flips from upside down to upright when the height goes negative.
B35.why: The flip is the claim; the picture turning right way up is what a viewer will want to see.

B36.visual_intent: A left-to-right chain on the cream stage: a dashed square holding the blob and card icons, then a tag 'inner shader', then the picture card, then a tag 'outer fragment: stripes', then a tag 'outer vertex: bend', then a screen frame with a wobbling frame on it. A token (the blob thumbnail) changes at each stage: plain, gradient, striped, striped and bent.
B36.motion_claim: The token passes each stage and changes its look: plain, gradient, striped, bent.
B36.why: A token that changes at every stage is the order of work, and the film's whole story, as motion.

B37.visual_intent: Three picture frames in a row: 'viewport' (the blob with an inner shader) leads to a picture, shown inside a second 'viewport' by a sprite with a fade shader, which leads to a second picture, shown on the screen by a sprite with a stripes shader. Three tags 'inner', 'middle' and 'outer'. A token flows along and picks up each shader's look.
B37.motion_claim: The token passes three shaders in a row, each time through a picture.
B37.why: A token passing three stations is the generalisation of the chain; the run in evidence proves it works.

click passes in; the button lights
